scope: Corollary 6.3 (Local weak-L4 gradient bound) of the manuscript “Interior regularity of planar Mumford–Shah minimizers” (preprints/Interior-regularity-of-planar-Mumford-Shah-minimizers-September-24-2026/Interior-regularity-of-planar-Mumford-Shah-minimizers-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 366 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5b03d80e25997de7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (u, K) satisfy the hypotheses of Theorem 1.1. Let ∇u denote the approximate gradient furnished by Proposition 2.1; it agrees almost everywhere on Ω\K with the gradient in (1.1). For every open U ⋐ Ω there is a constant CU < ∞, depending on U and the minimizer, such that L2 {x ∈ U \ K : |∇u(x)| > t}  ≤ CU t−4 for every t > 0, (6.1) where L2 denotes planar Lebesgue measure. In particular, ∇u ∈ L4,∞ loc (Ω) and ∇u ∈ Lp loc(Ω) for every 0 < p < 4.
